trials.instruction: Move the rectangular stapler with curved corners to the Cyan colored mat
Use the right arm to move the white stapler to Magenta mat
Place the red stapler with silver chamber on the Black colored mat.
Grab the stapler with white loading section and set it on Cyan mat
Place the red stapler with silver chamber on the Green colored mat.
Use the right arm to move the red plastic stapler to Magenta mat
Use the right arm to move the palm-sized black stapler to Black mat.
Place the rectangular stapler with curved corners on the Green mat
Move the black stapler to the Black colored mat
Place the small stapler with simple design on the Green colored mat.
